change: Give frontend editor state one explicit owner while preserving existing workflows.

implementation.state: One plain card.editors object owns confirmed configuration, scoped drafts and baselines, request status, validation, display units and picker state. The panel session retains that object directly; navigation and rendering remain on the card.
implementation.removed: The card-property allowlist and getter/setter forwarding; unused methodCancel and deliveryMethodReview writes.
implementation.boundaries: Replacement panels on the same authorized connection retain in-flight work without replay; user, permission and connection changes replace editor state and ignore obsolete responses.

typing.result: Success: no issues found in 43 source files

checks.full_python_suite_and_coverage: Not run for this frontend refactor and asset-identity update.

executable_regressions: tests/frontend/panel-drafts.test.mjs: validation, units and picker context follow drafts across panel replacement; a pending method test completes once in its replacement panel.
tests/frontend/delivery-picker.test.mjs: obsolete successful or failed preview/request replies cannot continue a test or modify replacement editor state.
tests/frontend/policy-picker.test.mjs: a retained broad-tree search cannot hide focused category choices; this assertion failed before restoring the existing search boundary.
Existing scoped-save, conflict, independent-draft, embedded-card, connection, user, permission, navigation and frontend-upgrade scenarios remain active.
